requirements.quote: `sandbox.unreachable` with an offline pool should not count toward `max_deferrals`, the same as `sandbox.capacity` after #4528.

When the pool has had zero live agents for more than N minutes:
  - print one loud batch event and notification;
with `fallback_local` unset, fall back to the host at a host-safe K, or at least report the stall in the status line.
**Fix:** derive `online` for the remote provider from `/agents` (`ok && !paused`), as `bin/pool/router.mjs` already does for the built-in pool, or treat a 503 or 502 streak as `online: 0`.

deliverables.change: Add sandbox.unreachable to UNCAPPED_DEFERRALS (update the comment at :23/:122); in grant() track the first sample with cap.online===0 and, once it exceeds the configured minutes (default 10), emit exactly one pool-offline update() batch event (status-line text names the stall, and a notification through any existing notify mechanism); reset when online>0. Do not force host fallback when fallback_local is unset (report only).
httpTransport.capacity(): when /status gives no valid online, GET /agents and set online=count(ok&&!paused), total=length; a failed /agents leaves online unknown. Update the doc comment.
Regression tests: deferPolicy uncaps sandbox.unreachable; a pool-offline event fires once after N minutes and resets.
Test capacity() derives online from /agents when /status is 404, and stays unknown when /agents fails.

preserve.what: UNCAPPED_DEFERRALS behaviour for host.busy and sandbox.capacity, and the capped rate_limited/sandbox.auth paths in bin/lean/orchestrate.mjs deferPolicy
httpTransport /status {free,online,total} parsing and the null-when-unknown contract in bin/lean/sandbox-remote.mjs; bin/pool/router.mjs /status unchanged
execution.fallback_local opt-in semantics (#4547): fallback only when set and online===0

decisions.choice: Uncap sandbox.unreachable unconditionally rather than gating on sampled online===0
decisions.justification: The unreachable lane error already waited unreachable_window_min (execution.mjs guard) and retries every 60s; a router that is down gives no online sample, so gating would miss the case that broke AlterLab. Mirrors #4528 (orchestrate.mjs:123).

decisions.choice: Stall is reported, not auto-routed to the host, when fallback_local is unset
decisions.justification: Issue allows 'or at least report'; auto host fallback would override an explicit opt-in (#4547) and NORTHSTAR 'never lose work/host safety'.
